meeting_point: Outside Arlington Street Church at intersection of Arlington & Boylston Streets
accessibility: Terrain level 1: Mostly flat surfaces and little to no inclines, stroller and wheelchair accessible
description: Boston’s Back Bay churches hold their own as spiritual sentinels of the city's skyline. Marvel at Back Bay’s most historic and architecturally significant churches including Trinity Church, the Arlington Street Church, the Church of the Covenant, and the Brattle Square Church. On this guided tour of the church exteriors, you’ll also explore the people behind these monumental buildings, and how their engineering and artistic creativity influenced church design and their continued preservation.
what_is_included:
- Guided 90 minute outdoor tour exploring a range of churches in the Back Bay neighborhood
- Approximately 1 mile tour at a moderate pace, stopping at various sites along the tour

what_is_not_included: - This tour does not include entrance into any of the churches, but remains outside of the sites exploring their history and architectural heritage
check_in_details:
- Please arrive 10 minutes before the tour start time to find your guide. Tours are held rain or shine.
- Finding Your Guide: All guides carry an 8×11 sign that says “Boston By Foot Walking Tours.”
- Nearest MBTA Station: Arlington (Green line)
what_to_bring:
- Comfortable shoes
- Dress for the weather (tours are held rain or shine)
- Water bottle
